title: New York's 19th Congressional District election, 2026
description: The 2026 election for New York's 19th Congressional District features first-term Democratic incumbent Josh Riley facing a Republican challenger in a nationally competitive swing seat. The district, which covers a swath of upstate New York stretching from the Hudson Valley to the Southern Tier, has a Cook Partisan Voting Index of D+1 and was decided by about two points in 2024 when Riley flipped the seat by defeating Republican Rep. Marc Molinaro. The Republican primary on June 23, 2026, pitted state Senator Peter Oberacker against political newcomer and entrepreneur Alexander Portelli. The outcome of this race will be closely watched as both parties compete for control of the U.S. House of Representatives in a district that has alternated between parties in recent cycles.
polling_note: No general election polling for the NY-19 race was found as of the current date. The most recent polling available was from the 2024 race between Josh Riley and Marc Molinaro.

candidates.name: Josh Riley
candidates.summary: Josh Riley is a Democratic U.S. Representative for New York's 19th Congressional District, first elected in 2024 after defeating Republican incumbent Marc Molinaro. A fifth-generation upstate New York native from Endicott, he worked as a policy analyst at the U.S. Department of Labor, served as general counsel to U.S. Senator Al Franken on the Senate Judiciary Committee, and later practiced law before running for Congress. In office, Riley has focused on bringing manufacturing jobs back to the district, lowering costs for working families, protecting Social Security and Medicare, and advancing campaign finance reform.

candidates.name: Peter Oberacker
candidates.summary: Peter Oberacker is a New York State Senator representing the 51st District, first elected in 2020, and a Republican candidate for New York's 19th Congressional District. A former business owner and local government official, he has served in town and county government prior to his state Senate tenure. Oberacker emphasizes his record of bipartisanship as a prolific law-passing Republican senator and is running on a platform focused on addressing rising utility costs, inflation, and affordability for families.

candidates.name: Alexander Portelli
candidates.summary: Alexander Portelli is a Republican candidate for New York's 19th Congressional District, an entrepreneur and political newcomer making his first run for elected office. He grew up in Albany, served in the U.S. Marine Corps (honorably discharged due to injury), and later owned a restaurant before launching an online media company and investing in real estate. Portelli owns a 120-acre timber farm in Otsego County and is running on a platform focused on reducing the national debt, repealing the income tax, ending foreign aid, and lowering energy costs.
